rationale: both_q combines outputs of two separately synchronized asynchronous sources (a_s2_q & b_s2_q): CDC-010(a) WARNING Heuristic reconvergence.

author_reading.rationale: Two independently synchronized source-domain bits are combined in one destination flop (reconvergence).

labels.rationale: Independent chains can resolve the two related bits in different destination cycles. both_q can combine a pair of values that was never active together in the source domain.

Two separately synchronized signals a_s2_q and b_s2_q (from a_src_q and b_src_q in src_clk) reconverge through combinational AND logic into destination register both_q (both_q <= a_s2_q & b_s2_q at design.sv:29), losing relative cycle correlation across the independent synchronizer chains (CDC-010 WARNING Heuristic).
